 Gold and Silver rate: Gold and silver indicative jewellery prices decreased today, but retail prices for 22k jewellery remained stable across various cities. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association provided updates on gold and silver rates for various purity levels. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online Gold rate today: 24k vs 22k vs 20k vs 18k prices Gold and silver indicative jewellery prices slipped today (Thursday, October 29, 2026 ) as per the latest update by the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA). However, 22k retail jewellery prices at Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas remained unchanged across Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata and Trivandrum.
 Gold Outlook:
Prithviraj Kothari, Managing Director at RiddiSiddhi Bullions Ltd., President of IBJA says "Gold and silver are holding near key supports as markets digest the Fed’s decision to keep rates unchanged and wait for today’s US inflation data. Two policymakers voted for a 25-bps hike, which has raised the odds of a December increase as energy-driven inflation persists. Chair Kevin Warsh’s idea of cutting rate meetings from eight to six adds to the uncertainty. High oil prices keep inflation risks alive, which could weigh on silver. Technically, gold has slipped below $4,000 and silver below $54.5, with near-term downside possible. Still, the $3,950–4,000 and $50–55 zones look like strong accumulation area."
